methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Pre-Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $2M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Drones & Autonomous (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 5 same-sector peers exist in Drones & Autonomous, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
DroneForge is a pre-seed stage company in the Drones & Autonomous sector, having raised $2.5M to date. The valuation universe comprises six private peers in the sector, including Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro, Archer Aviation, and Elroy Air. No public comparables exist in this narrowly defined category.

Given the limited peer data at the pre-seed stage, stage-progression methodology is the applicable triangulation method. This approach uses the $2.5M total raised as a proxy for current value and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical for pre-seed to next-stage advancement, yielding an implied valuation of $6M. A peer-median approach proved inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage datapoints within the Drones & Autonomous sector—only zero comparables met the narrow filtering criteria, making sector-wide aggregation misleading.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $5M to $7M, with a median point estimate of $6M. This single-method triangulation carries elevated uncertainty inherent to pre-seed valuations, where comparable transaction data is sparse and stage progression multiples are subject to market conditions and investor sentiment. Key variables affecting valuation include product-market validation milestones, competitive positioning relative to the named peer set, and capital efficiency relative to sector benchmarks. Investors should treat this range as indicative pending deeper operational diligence.
